item.title: Shettima arrives Côte d’Ivoire for Ouattara’s inauguration
item.description: Vice President Kashim Shettima has arrived in Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire, where he is representing President Bola Tinubu at the swearing-in of President Alassane Ouattara for his fourth term in office. This was contained in a statement from the Office of the Vice President. item.title: We may join contractors, pensioners in protests against govt over debts – ADC warns
item.description: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has strongly criticised the Federal Government over its mounting debts to local contractors and pensioners, saying the situation is a clear sign of insensitivity to the suffering of ordinary Nigerians. item.title: Constituency projects fund should go to security – Ex-Defense spokesman, Enenche
item.description: A former Defense spokesman, Maj-Gen John Enenche (rtd) has said that the money given to lawmakers for constituency projects should go to security instead. General Enenche made this statement in an interview on ‘Sunday Politics’, a programme on Channels Television monitored by DAILY POST. He was reacting to the wave of insecurity bedeviling the country […] Constituency projects fund should go to security – Ex-Defense spokesman, Enenche

item.title: Kano insecurity: Ganduje interference will worsen situation in state – Hassan Ibrahim
item.description: Amid rising insecurity in parts of Kano State, political analyst, Hassan Ibrahim has cautioned former Governor, Abdullahi Umar Ganduje to stop meddling in security issues in the state. He also advised Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf to put politics aside and prioritise the safety of residents. He took this position in an exclusive interview with DAILYPOST. item.title: PDP faction constitutes National Caretaker Committee as NWC tenure ends Tuesday
item.description: The ‎Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, National Executive Committee, NEC, has constituted a National Caretaker Committee, to manage the party’s affairs until a national convention is held. ‎ ‎NEC constituted the caretaker committee because the tenure of the current PDP National Working Committee, NWC, ends on Tuesday, December 9, 2025. ‎ ‎This decision was taken during […] PDP faction constitutes National Caretaker Committee as NWC tenure ends Tuesday
